Paper_Metadata.Paper_Title: Dual-layer hybrid solid electrolyte for improved interfacial stability in solid-state lithium batteries

Composition.Formula_Note: x=0.075 in Li1.3Al0.3ZrxTi1.7-x(PO4)3 series; LiNO3 added with 10 mol% excess to compensate for Li loss during calcination

Process_Text.original: Pechini sol-gel method: solvent mixture of deionized water and HNO3 (3:1 v/v), Ti(CaH2O)4 added under stirring, citric acid chelating agent (2:1 molar ratio to total metal cations), LiNO3 (99%, Sigma Aldrich) with 10 mol% excess, Al(NO3)3·9H2O, ZrO(NO3)2·xH2O (x=4, 99%, Sigma Aldrich) dissolved in DI water, pH adjusted to 5 with NH4OH, NH4H2PO4 added, ethylene glycol (1:1 M ratio with citric acid) as dispersant, heated at 85 °C for 48 h for gel formation, pre-calcined in muffle furnace at 250 °C for 5 h, calcined at 850 °C for 5 h in air in tube furnace
Process_Text.simplified: Pechini sol-gel synthesis of LAZTP powder: precursors dissolved in HNO3/water, chelated with citric acid, pH=5, dried at 85 °C/48 h, pre-calcined 250 °C/5 h, calcined 850 °C/5 h in air

Key_Params.Chelating_Agent: Citric acid, 2:1 molar ratio to total metal cations
Key_Params.Dispersant: Ethylene glycol, 1:1 M ratio with citric acid

Structure_Text.original: All samples indexed to the rhombohedral LiTi2(PO4)3 phase with the R-3c space group (COD 7222155). No Zr-related impurity phases detected. Lattice expansion confirmed by systematic shift of (113) peak to lower 2θ with increasing Zr content. Interplanar distance for (113) plane increased to 0.366 nm for LAZTP-0.075. Powders consisted of nanometer-sized primary particles agglomerated into secondary particles with diameters below approximately 3–5 μm.
Structure_Text.simplified: NASICON-type rhombohedral phase (R-3c, COD 7222155), single phase at 850 °C, lattice expanded by Zr doping, (113) d-spacing = 0.366 nm, agglomerated particles ~3–5 μm

Phase_Composition.Purity: Single phase at 850 °C, no Zr-related impurity

Particle_Size.Note: Nanometer-sized primary particles agglomerated into secondary particles

Layer_1_Oxide_Rich.Layer_Role: Oxide-rich bottom layer; enhances ionic transport, electrochemical oxidative stability, and mechanical strength; faces cathode side

Layer_2_Polymer_Rich.Layer_Role: Polymer-rich top layer; provides smooth and uniform interface with Li metal anode, blocks side reactions with LAZTP

Composition.Note: Dual-layer membrane: oxide-rich layer (69 μm) + polymer-rich layer (48 μm); total thickness approximately 117 μm (derived from layer thicknesses)

Process_Text.original: PVDF-HFP and LiTFSI dissolved in DMAc at 50 °C. LAZTP powders incorporated at 50 wt% relative to combined weight of polymer and oxide, stirred 12 h. Oxide-rich slurry cast onto glass Petri dish and vacuum-dried at 50 °C for 6 h. Polymer solution without oxide fillers cast on top, vacuum-dried at 50 °C for 24 h. Peeled off at room temperature and stored in Ar-filled glovebox.
Process_Text.simplified: Two-step solution casting: first cast oxide-rich (50 wt% LAZTP) slurry, vacuum-dry 50 °C/6 h, then cast polymer-rich solution on top, vacuum-dry 50 °C/24 h, peel at RT, store in Ar glovebox

Structure_Text.original: Cross-sectional SEM clearly reveals distinct dual-layer structure with oxide-rich layer (69 μm) and polymer-rich layer (48 μm). Surface of polymer-rich layer shows smaller crystallites (~8.2 μm) and reduced porosity. XRD shows characteristic peaks of PVDF-HFP at 2θ = 18°, 20°, 39° corresponding to α and β phases along with LAZTP peaks.
Structure_Text.simplified: Dual-layer structure: oxide-rich 69 μm + polymer-rich 48 μm; surface crystallites ~8.2 μm; PVDF-HFP α and β phases + LAZTP NASICON peaks in XRD
